terms.gloss: a particle, a small indeclinable word
terms.comment: Literally “a little part”. Traupman applies it to the four indeclinable parts of speech (adverb, preposition, conjunction, interjection; 248) and to -nam in quisnam (225).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 225, p. 248.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
